name: LiveBench-6
description: Automated large-scale evaluation of protein structure prediction servers, measuring the accuracy and performance of predicted protein structures against experimental data.
reputation: Well-known continuous benchmarking platform for protein structure prediction servers, historically used alongside CASP to track server performance.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; continuous online evaluation tied to newly released experimental structures; results sensitive to target selection and availability; possible overlap/contamination with server training data for some methods.
